MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.title: Agree
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.description:
Triggered by multiples of 1 to 5 
 × 1: All allies get 3 shields 
 × 2: All allies get 3 shields 
 × 3: All allies get 1 layer of temporary swift 
 × 4: All allies get 2 layers of temporary power 
 × 5: 1 random hand card can be played 1 time for free, all allies get 1 point of energy

 × 2: Draw 1 card for self 
 × 3: Gain 1 point of energy for self 
 × 4: Recycle 1 deck of discarded cards 
 × 5: 1 hand Add replay 1, 1 hand get 1 [color=#339966] [[/color] [color=#cc9966] review [/color] [color=#6699cc] judge [/color] [color=#339966]] [/color] enchantment
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.title: Rebuttal
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.descriptio:
Triggered by multiples of 1 to 5

 x2: Gain 1 power 
 x3: All enemies gain 1 stack of Vulnerability
